metaTitle: Custom Flannel Pants Shorts | Perfect Imprints
metaDescription: Order custom flannel pants shorts in bulk for your team. Soft, durable, and perfect for branding with embroidery or screen printing.
introHtml: Flannel pants and shorts combine the comfort of brushed cotton with the durability needed for workwear or casual team uniforms. Unlike standard polyester blends, flannel offers a soft, lived-in feel from the first wear while holding up to frequent washing. These are ideal for seasonal giveaways, employee appreciation, or retail stock where warmth and a rugged aesthetic matter. Decorate with left-chest embroidery or screen-printed logos for a polished look that stands out from basic fleece or denim options.
heroAltText: Custom flannel pants shorts with embroidered logo on front pocket, showing soft brushed fabric and relaxed fit
